motion.purpose: Moves customer-facing copy through directional clip-path entrances and faster inverse exits; body copy may follow its heading by no more than 90ms.

components.css: .ds-studio { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8vw; padding:6vw; background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-studio-image { position:relative; min-height:520px; border:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.12); background:#20211e; } .ds-studio-image span { position:absolute; right:16px; bottom:16px; padding:7px 9px; background:#d9f45f; color:#11110f; font-family:Marcellus,serif; } .ds-studio article { align-self:center; } .ds-studio h2 { font:400 clamp(48px,6vw,88px)/.95 Marcellus,serif; } .ds-studio p { max-width:34ch; color:#b0aea5; font:400 17px/1.9 'Zen Old Mincho',serif; }

components.name: Perspective Salon Gallery
components.description: Sticky narrative beside three asymmetric exhibit lanes; ten works are sampled from a twenty-image pool in a 4/3/3 distribution, preserve their full 4:5 canvas, and use generous spacing, plane-specific shadows, parallax, focus-clearing blur, and a velocity-shaped colorful WebGL RGB separation for depth.
components.html: Worlds in motion.
components.css: .ds-waterfall { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.54fr 1.46fr; background:#1b1b18; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-waterfall header { position:sticky; top:20vh; align-self:start; padding:15vh 6vw; } .ds-streams { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.12fr .78fr; gap:1.8vw; padding:18vh 3vw 20vh 0; } .ds-streams div { min-height:1200px; background:#11110f; } .ds-streams .far { transform:scale(.82); opacity:.68; } .ds-streams .near { transform:scale(1.08); } .ds-streams .mid { transform:scale(.93); opacity:.9; }

components.name: Low-Chroma Instagram Rail
components.description: One load-shuffled row of all twenty supplied 4:5 Instagram works that compacts into two synchronized rows at 720px and below; the complete More from section converts bounded vertical wheel input into horizontal movement while images remain uncropped, lazy-load, and restore color on focus.
components.css: .ds-instagram { overflow:hidden; padding:10vw 0; background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-instagram div { display:grid; width:max-content; grid-auto-columns:clamp(180px,18vw,292px); grid-auto-flow:column; gap:1vw; overflow-x:auto; scroll-snap-type:x proximity; } .ds-instagram a { aspect-ratio:4/5; scroll-snap-align:start; filter:grayscale(1) saturate(.1); opacity:.7; transition:filter 360ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity 240ms ease; } .ds-instagram img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; } .ds-instagram a:hover,.ds-instagram a:focus-visible { filter:none; opacity:1; } @media(max-width:720px){.ds-instagram div{grid-template-rows:repeat(2,min(51vw,195px));grid-auto-columns:min(40.8vw,156px)}}

components.name: Filterable Web Archive

components.html: 4 projects
components.css: .ds-archive { padding:72px 0; background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; font-family:Marcellus,serif; } .ds-archive-filters { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 18px; } .ds-archive-filters button { min-height:38px; padding:0 0 2px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid transparent; background:transparent; color:#b0aea5; font:400 12px/1.2 Marcellus,serif; } .ds-archive-filters button:hover,.ds-archive-filters button[aria-pressed=true] { border-color:#d9f45f; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-archive-filters button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9f45f; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-archive-status { min-height:1.6em; margin:12px 0 30px; color:#b0aea5; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-archive-flow { columns:2; column-gap:28px; } .ds-archive-flow article { display:inline-block; width:100%; height:220px; margin:0 0 28px; break-inside:avoid; background:#1b1b18; }

components.css: .ds-admin { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.28fr; gap:1px; background:rgba(242,241,235,.2); color:#f2f1eb; font-family:'Zen Old Mincho',serif; } .ds-admin aside,.ds-admin form { padding:32px; background:#11110f; } .ds-admin h2,.ds-admin strong,.ds-admin button,.ds-admin select { font-family:Marcellus,serif; } .ds-admin-item { margin-top:24px; padding:18px; border:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.2); } .ds-admin label { display:grid; gap:8px; margin-top:18px; } .ds-admin input,.ds-admin select { min-height:48px; padding:10px 0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.38); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-admin button { min-height:44px; margin-top:18px; border:1px solid #d9f45f; border-radius:0; background:#d9f45f; color:#11110f; } .ds-admin :focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d9f45f; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Project Inquiry Dialog
components.description: Full-viewport native dialog with a fixed dark header and a reduced-motion-safe clip-path reveal; Escape, close and backdrop interactions return focus to the opener.
components.html: NeoRealm LAB
components.css: .ds-inquiry { inset:0; width:100vw; max-width:none; height:100dvh; max-height:none; margin:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; border:0; background:transparent; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-inquiry::backdrop { background:rgba(5,6,5,.86); backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(78%); } .ds-inquiry-shell { width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:#11110f; clip-path:inset(100% 0 0); transform:translate3d(0,36px,0); transition:clip-path 760ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 760ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-inquiry[open] .ds-inquiry-shell { clip-path:inset(0); transform:none; } .ds-inquiry header { position:absolute; inset:0 0 auto; z-index:6; display:flex; min-height:72px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:10px clamp(18px,4vw,64px); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.18); background:rgba(12,13,12,.9); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-inquiry-shell{clip-path:none;transform:none;transition:none;}}

components.name: Inquiry Pricing and Proposal
components.description: Two-act inquiry: a dark three-column pricing ledger where only the hovered or keyboard-focused plan becomes Acid Signal, followed by a warm-white underline-field proposal sheet.
components.css: .ds-pricing { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); border-block:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.2); background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-pricing article { min-height:520px; padding:clamp(30px,4vw,58px) clamp(22px,3vw,44px); border-right:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.2); background:transparent; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-pricing article:hover,.ds-pricing article:focus-within { background:#d9f45f; color:#11110f; } .ds-proposal { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.28fr; min-height:100dvh; padding:clamp(120px,16vh,180px) clamp(22px,6vw,96px); background:#f2f1eb; color:#11110f; } .ds-proposal input,.ds-proposal select,.ds-proposal textarea { width:100%; min-height:54px; padding:10px 0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(17,17,15,.38); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#11110f; } @media(max-width:720px){.ds-pricing,.ds-proposal form{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-pricing article{min-height:0;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.2)}.ds-proposal{display:block;}}

narrative.overview: NeoRealm LAB treats the selected site as an authored cinematic field. Graphite surfaces, Projection White type, one Acid Signal, a three-plane salon gallery, a low-chroma Instagram rail, and fluid pointer trails prove current web, AI visual, and motion capability before a filterable supporting archive appears; a separate restrained editor manages that archive through a replaceable local content adapter.
keyCharacteristics: Direction B is selected; Direction A remains comparison apparatus only.
Marcellus carries English display, navigation, and labels; Zen Old Mincho carries Chinese and body reading.
The supplied SVG wordmark anchors the navigation.
The 178dvh KV uses the supplied video and a clean loading poster.
Studio synchronizes three generated abstract images with three scrolling chapters.
The Studio visual is flush with the viewport's left edge and navigation-to-bottom height on desktop.

Three asymmetric work planes sample ten full 4:5 canvases in a 4/3/3 distribution and use generous spacing, plane-specific shadows, parallax, and optical blur for depth; a shuffled twenty-image low-chroma rail accepts section-wide bounded wheel-to-horizontal input.
Mobile and reduced-motion modes remove nonessential transforms and video playback.
Project inquiry moves from a dark editorial pricing ledger to an inverted warm-white proposal sheet inside a full-viewport native dialog.

The web archive reflows through three customer-legible categories, while a local Operate-mode editor manages image, copy, category, layout, deletion, and order without implying production authentication or durable cloud storage.
The live interface demonstrates current web skill without exposing internal strategy; legacy work is supporting provenance.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: Projection White and graphite neutrals carry most screens so Acid Signal remains rare enough to direct attention.

rules.name: The Marcellus Frame Rule
rules.body: Use Marcellus for English, display, navigation, labels, and release naming.

rules.name: The Zen Reading Rule
rules.body: Use Zen Old Mincho for Chinese and body reading.

rules.name: The Two-Message KV Rule
rules.body: The primary copy exits before the reveal copy enters during ordinary motion.

rules.name: The Sticky Counterpoint Rule
rules.body: Studio holds one visual field while three text chapters advance.

rules.name: The Perspective Salon Rule
rules.body: Selected work changes scale, speed, and lateral position by plane and never returns to equal card columns.

rules.name: The Full-Frame Plate Rule
rules.body: Preserve the supplied 4:5 post canvas with contain fitting; never crop artwork to manufacture depth.

rules.name: The Optical Depth Rule
rules.body: Only middle and far gallery planes blur; pointer hover and keyboard focus restore full clarity before the image opens in a native lightbox.

rules.name: The Color-on-Approach Rule
rules.body: The Instagram field stays low-chroma until pointer hover or keyboard focus restores original color.

rules.name: The Bounded Color Rule
rules.body: Fine-pointer media response uses a local, velocity-shaped RGB separation and never becomes free dragging or reordering.

rules.name: The Motion-Off Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion pauses video and removes parallax, card drift, and ghost layers.

rules.name: The Filtered Provenance Rule
rules.body: Archive categories reflow the visible masonry stream and announce the resulting count through a polite live region.

rules.name: The Local-Is-Not-Production Rule
rules.body: The admin page and localStorage are prototype tools only; production requires authentication, durable database records, and external object storage.

rules.name: The Sharp System Rule
rules.body: Production geometry stays rectangular; prototype pills do not enter the product identity.

rules.name: The Two-Act Inquiry Rule
rules.body: Qualify with a dark pricing ledger, then invert to a warm-white proposal sheet; do not collapse the sequence into rounded cards.

rules.name: The Active-Plan Signal Rule
rules.body: Within pricing, Acid Signal appears only on the plan currently approached by pointer or keyboard focus.

dos: Do use Marcellus for English, display, navigation, labels, and release titles.
Do use Zen Old Mincho for Chinese and body reading.
Do preserve the supplied SVG wordmark and white-on-black navigation treatment.
Do preserve the two-message 178dvh KV and its user-provided video/poster relationship.
Do keep Studio as a 50/50 sticky-image narrative with three scrolling steps.
Do let the current interface prove web capability without narrating internal strategy.
Do keep waterfall interaction bounded to fine-pointer desktop.
Do keep archive filters keyboard accessible and announce the visible project count.
Do label the local editor as a prototype and preserve the authentication, database, and object-storage production boundary.
Do use the native dialog top layer and restore focus to the exact inquiry opener after every close path.
Do stack pricing and collapse the proposal form to one column at 720px and below.
Do report form loading, success, and recoverable error copy through a restrained polite live region.
Do fully remove video playback and transforms for reduced motion.
donts: Don't substitute generic sans-serif typography for the selected Marcellus and Zen Old Mincho roles.
Don't expose the QR intro from the supplied video as the KV first frame.
Don't make both KV messages compete during ordinary motion.
Don't turn Studio into a carousel or uniform card grid.
Don't allow release cards to reorder or move without bounds.
Don't enable pointer effects on mobile.
Don't present localStorage or compressed browser image data as a production CMS.
Don't leave a pricing plan permanently in Acid Signal or turn the ledger into floating rounded cards.
Don't wrap proposal fields in cards; keep the warm-white sheet and underline-only controls.
Don't let legacy cases outrank the current experience.
Don't add glow, glossy glass cards, dashboard styling, or cursor tricks outside the media trails.
